name: M3M Crown
summary: The project, developer (M3M India), Sector 111 Dwarka Expressway location, RERA GGM/687/419/2023/31, under-construction status, 16 acres, 11 towers, 1,332 units and ~₹3.3-3.4 Cr starting price are confirmed by most sources. Our possession date (Dec 2028) is about 11 months later than the January 2028 that most portals cite (one says Feb 2028). Some sources give unit sizes of 1,555-2,525 sq ft rather than our 1,605-2,670, and sources disagree on land area, tower and unit counts.
